page.title: Project team
page.description: Who works on this project and what each person may do here. Capabilities apply to this project only.

viewer.orgAdmin: As an organization admin you hold every capability on every project. Team members here only get what you choose for them.
viewer.readOnly: You can see the team and their capabilities. Adding people or changing capabilities requires "Manage the project team".

members.heading: {count, plural, =0 {No active team members} one {One active team member} other {# active team members}}
members.description: Each person gets their own set of capabilities. A template is only a starting point - adjust it per person.
members.emptyTitle: No one is on the project team yet
members.emptyManage: Add people from your organization - including Employee App users - and choose what each of them may do.
members.emptyReadOnly: The team manager has not added anyone to this project yet.
members.inactiveHeading: {count, plural, one {One inactive team member} other {# inactive team members}}
members.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name} on this project? All of their project capabilities stop until they are reactivated.

add.title: Add a project team member
add.description: Choose a person from your organization and set what they may do on this project.
add.personPlaceholder: Choose a person from your organization
add.personHint: Only active organization members who are not on the team yet are listed. Subcontractors get access through the contractor portal.
add.noCandidates: Every active organization member is already on this project team.
add.chooseCapabilities: Choose a template or select at least one capability.

edit.title: Capabilities of {name}
edit.description: Select what this person may do on the project. You can only grant or remove capabilities you hold yourself.
edit.viewDescription: Summary of capabilities on this project.

editor.templateHint: Picking a template fills in the capabilities. You can then add or remove individual capabilities.
editor.financialWarning: These capabilities reveal contract values, prices, progress claims, retention and contractor payments. They are never implied by operational capabilities - grant them only to people who truly need them.
editor.notGrantable: You do not hold this capability, so you cannot grant or remove it.
editor.addingFinancialTitle: Heads up: financial access is being added
editor.addingFinancial: After saving, this person will see project and contractor financial data according to the capabilities you selected.
editor.changeSummary: {added, plural, one {One capability} other {# capabilities}} will be added and {removed, plural, one {one} other {#}} removed.
editor.beyondActor: This change includes capabilities you do not hold. You can only change capabilities you hold on this project.

groupDescriptions.operational: Day-to-day site and project work - no amounts visible.
groupDescriptions.financial: Seeing amounts and making financial decisions on contractors and the budget.
groupDescriptions.administrative: Managing the team, contractor access and project settings.

capabilityHints.project_view: Open the project and see its operational data.
capabilityHints.project_manage: Edit details, structure and locations of the project.
capabilityHints.schedule_manage: Manage activities, milestones and coordination events.
capabilityHints.contractor_view: See contractors on the project, without contract amounts.
capabilityHints.contractor_coordinate: Coordinate contractors and issue site instructions.
capabilityHints.progress_verify: Confirm that work was completed on site.
capabilityHints.documents_share: Publish plan revisions and share documents with contractors.
capabilityHints.rfi_manage: Raise, answer and close requests for information.
capabilityHints.submittal_manage: Review submittals and approve materials and products.
capabilityHints.daily_log_manage: Fill in the daily site log.
capabilityHints.safety_manage: Record safety events and corrective actions.
capabilityHints.contract_financial_view: See contractor contract values and prices.
capabilityHints.contract_manage: Create and edit contractor contracts and work lines.
capabilityHints.change_financial_manage: Price, negotiate and approve contractor changes.
capabilityHints.claim_view: See contractor progress claims and amounts.
capabilityHints.claim_certify: Give final certification of progress claims.
capabilityHints.deductions_manage: Record deductions and back-charges to contractors.
capabilityHints.retention_manage: Manage retention amounts and their release.
capabilityHints.project_budget_view: See the budget and cost control.
capabilityHints.contractor_invite: Invite contractor companies and their users.
capabilityHints.external_access_manage: Manage access grants of external users.
capabilityHints.project_team_manage: Add people to the team and set their capabilities.

errors.grantBeyondAuthority: You cannot grant capabilities you do not hold on this project yourself: {capabilities}.
errors.revokeBeyondAuthority: You cannot remove capabilities you do not hold yourself: {capabilities}. Ask someone who holds them.
errors.deactivateHigherAuthority: You cannot deactivate a team member who holds capabilities you do not have. Ask the project manager or an organization admin.
errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to manage this project team.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already on the project team. If they are inactive, reactivate them instead.
errors.notOrgMember: Only active organization members can join the project team.
errors.noCapabilities: A team member needs at least one capability.
errors.unknownTemplate: The selected capability template does not exist.
errors.invalidInput: Some details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.notFound: The project or team member was not found.

toasts.deactivated: Team member deactivated on the project
